title: RepoAssure Final Product Acceptance Maintainer Decision Recording v0.1
objective: Record exactly one explicit maintainer decision of accepted, changes_requested, or defer from the final product acceptance decision package, preserve concrete notes and evidence boundaries, and select a bounded follow-up without inferring a decision or changing product, target repository, release, or external state.
acceptance: Record only an explicit maintainer choice of accepted, changes_requested, or defer; do not infer a choice from Goal execution authorization.
Require concrete maintainer notes and preserve the evidence, freshness, and coverage boundaries from the decision package.
If no explicit choice is provided, keep the decision pending and do not claim final product acceptance.
Select a bounded follow-up consistent with the explicit choice without treating product acceptance as publication, deployment, launch, target repository, or hosted availability authorization.

Do not run or write a target repository, change runtime or acceptance policy, publish, deploy, launch, modify repository controls, contact anyone, change pricing or spend, claim hosted availability, or rewrite Git history.

summary.maintainer_notes: 当前自动化质量证据已通过，暂未发现必须返工的产品缺陷；但现有真实项目验收早于当前产品状态，且只覆盖单一 browser 场景。等待当前版本完成 Web、Python/CLI、MCP/Agent 三类代表性真实验收闭环，并关闭关键误报与人工决策项后，再进行最终 accepted 决策。
